CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid plugins by tabilzad, maintained on GitHub. This repository is the Community Applications feed: it holds the listing metadata only (MIT licensed), and each plugin's code, licence, releases and issues live in its own repository. Plugins: Docker Batch Update, which adds a Batch Update tab to the Docker page for updating the containers you pick in one go; Claude Code for Unraid, which installs Anthropic's Claude Code command-line agent natively on the host with a persistent login, restorable sessions and an enforced safety policy (a community project, not affiliated with Anthropic or Lime Technology); and GPU Unlock, which runs the gpu_unlock kernel module from Zagitta/gpu-unlock at boot to unlock the full FP16/BF16 tensor rate of GeForce RTX 30 series cards before the NVIDIA driver loads (not affiliated with NVIDIA, Lime Technology or the gpu-unlock authors). Support: the forum thread or the GitHub issues linked from each plugin.
